**Does it involve permissions?**
Lyra asks for Automation (to read Spotify and Music) and System Audio Recording (for the lights).
Tell us which prompts you saw and whether you allowed them.

**Logs (optional)**
Run the app from a terminal with `LYRA_DEBUG=1` and paste anything relevant:

```
"/Applications/Lyra.app/Contents/MacOS/Lyra"
```

Please do not paste song lyrics; the track title and artist are enough.
